dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Highly prominent and sharp pale borders define the boundaries of the folded primary and secondary feathers against dark centers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: A distinct color and pattern shift from a relatively uniform brown crown to a heavily streaked and scaled mantle area.

other_distinctive_markers: The entire dorsal surface displays a repetitive, high-contrast scalloped pattern due to broad white fringes on dark feathers.
